# MECHANISM: Use a piecewise linear function with more breakpoints to better capture the trade-off between remaining capacity and priority.
def priority(item, bins):
    breakpoints = np.array([150, 120, 100, 80, 60, 40, 20, 10, 0])
    weights = np.array([1.0, 0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05, 0.02, 0.01])
    scores = np.zeros_like(bins)
    
    for bp, wt in zip(breakpoints, weights):
        mask = bins >= bp
        scores[mask] = wt * (150 - bins[mask]) / (150 - bp)
    
    return scores
